## Common WHERE Filters

| Filter Column | Common Values / Patterns | Frequency |
|---------------|--------------------------|-----------|
| `grass_date` | `BETWEEN date('${grass_date_30day}') AND date('${grass_date}')` (workflows), `= date '${BIZ_YESTERDAY}'` (daily tasks) | All queries |
| `grass_region` | `= upper('${region}')` (single region), `IN (${region})` (multi-region) | All queries |
| `is_bi_excluded_rev_prm` | `= 0` (exclude test/bi-excluded orders) | ~80% of queries |
| `is_bi_excluded_order` | `= 0` (exclude bi-excluded orders) | mgmt_order_item_day |
| `regional_create_date` | Time-range filter alongside grass_date for accurate regional date window | PC2 workflows |
| `cancel_datetime` | `IS NULL` (filter cancelled orders) | Commission stat tasks |
| `is_returned_item` | `= 0` (filter returned items) | Commission stat tasks |

## Representative SQL Snippets

### Snippet 1: Revenue extraction for PC2 workflow (commission + handling fees)

```sql
create or replace temporary view central_base as
select
    regional_create_date as grass_date
    ,order_id, item_id, model_id, group_id, bundle_order_item_id
    ,coalesce(estimate_mandatory_commission_fee_usd_level1, 0) as estimate_mandatory_commission_fee_usd_level1_1d
    ,coalesce(estimate_local_c2c_mandatory_commission_fee_usd_level1, 0) as estimate_local_c2c_mandatory_commission_fee_usd_level1_1d
    ,coalesce(estimate_local_mall_mandatory_commission_fee_usd_level1, 0) as estimate_local_mall_mandatory_commission_fee_usd_level1_1d
    ,coalesce(estimate_cb_mandatory_commission_fee_usd_level1, 0) as estimate_cb_mandatory_commission_fee_usd_level1_1d
    ,coalesce(estimate_optional_commission_fee_usd_level1, 0) as estimate_optional_commission_fee_usd_level1_1d
    ,coalesce(estimate_buyer_handling_fee_usd_level1, 0) + coalesce(estimate_seller_handling_fee_usd_level1, 0) as handling_fee_usd
    ,estimate_other_revenue_usd_level2
from mp_mgmt.dws_order_item_rev_di__reg_s0_live
where grass_region = upper('${region}')
  and grass_date between date_add(date('${grass_date_30day}'), -1) and date('${grass_date}')
  and regional_create_date >= date('${grass_date_30day}')
  and regional_create_date < date_add(date('${grass_date}'), 1)
  and is_bi_excluded_rev_prm = 0
;
```

### Snippet 2: Commission base extraction for ads model (with 14d window)

```sql
WITH central_order_14d AS (
    SELECT
        order_id, item_id, model_id, group_id, bundle_order_item_id
        ,grass_date, grass_region
        ,SUM(COALESCE(CAST(commission_base_amt_usd AS DOUBLE), 0)) AS commission_base_amt_usd
    FROM mp_mgmt.dws_order_item_rev_di__reg_s0_live
    WHERE grass_date >= DATE '${PREV_14D}' AND grass_date <= DATE '${BIZ_YESTERDAY}'
        AND grass_region IN (${region})
    GROUP BY order_id, item_id, model_id, group_id, bundle_order_item_id, grass_date, grass_region
)
...
JOIN central_order_14d central
    ON omni.order_id = central.order_id
    AND omni.item_id = central.item_id
    AND omni.model_id = central.model_id
    AND omni.group_id = central.group_id
    AND omni.bundle_order_item_id = central.bundle_order_item_id
    AND omni.grass_region = central.grass_region
WHERE central.commission_base_amt_usd > 0
```

### Snippet 3: Item-level commission statistics (1p, with rolling windows)

```sql
SELECT
    item_id, shop_id
    ,MAX(level1_global_be_category_id) as level1_global_be_category_id
    ,MAX(level1_global_be_category) as level1_global_be_category
    ,SUM(IF(local_create_date >= '${BIZ_YESTERDAY}', commission_base_amt_usd, 0)) as commission_base_amt_usd_1d
    ,SUM(IF(local_create_date >= date_sub('${BIZ_YESTERDAY}', 6), commission_base_amt_usd, 0)) as commission_base_amt_usd_7d
    ,SUM(IF(local_create_date >= date_sub('${BIZ_YESTERDAY}', 13), commission_base_amt_usd, 0)) as commission_base_amt_usd_14d
    ,SUM(IF(local_create_date >= '${BIZ_YESTERDAY}', commission_fee_usd, 0)) as commission_fee_usd_1d
    ,SUM(IF(local_create_date >= '${BIZ_YESTERDAY}', service_fee_usd, 0)) as service_fee_usd_1d
    ,grass_region as country
FROM mp_mgmt.dws_order_item_rev_di__reg_s0_live
WHERE grass_date >= date_sub('${BIZ_YESTERDAY}', 27)
  AND grass_date <= date '${BIZ_YESTERDAY}'
  AND cancel_datetime IS NULL
  AND is_bi_excluded_order = 0
  AND COALESCE(is_returned_item, 0) = 0
GROUP BY item_id, shop_id, grass_region
```

### Snippet 4: Daily order-item data export

```sql
INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mgmt_order_item_day PARTITION (dt = '${BIZ_YESTERDAY}', country)
SELECT
    item_id, shop_id
    ,level1_global_be_category_id, level1_global_be_category
    ,create_datetime
    ,commission_base_amt_usd, commission_fee_usd, service_fee_usd
    ,grass_region
FROM mp_mgmt.dws_order_item_rev_di__reg_s0_live
WHERE grass_date = date '${BIZ_YESTERDAY}' AND is_bi_excluded_order = 0;
```

### Snippet 5: Revenue diff validation query

```sql
select 'mp_rev', sum(estimate_mandatory_commission_fee_usd_level1_1d), null
from mp_mgmt.dws_order_item_rev_di__reg_s0_live
where grass_region='SG' and grass_date=date'2025-12-01' and is_bi_excluded_rev_prm = 0
union all
select 'mp_rebate', null, sum(estimate_net__total_item_voucher_logst_prm_usd_level1)
from mp_mgmt.dws_order_item_rebate_di__reg_s0_live
where grass_region='SG' and grass_date=date'2025-12-01' and is_bi_excluded_rev_prm = 0
;
```
